notes: Validated against Serganov et al. Nature 2006 (doi:10.1038/nature04740). 2GDI structure: Arabidopsis thaliana TPP riboswitch with CCC (pyrithiamine PP analog). CRITICAL: thiazole ring is NOT recognised by the RNA — only the aminopyrimidine (HMP) arm and pyrophosphate tail are contacted. Aminopyrimidine: continuous stacking A41-G42-HMP-A43-G21; base triples (G19·A47)·G42 and (G18-C48)·A41 stabilise the pocket. G40 and G19 2'-OH H-bond to polar aminopyrimidine groups. Pyrophosphate: two Mg²⁺ ions (Mg1/Mg2) coordinate the phosphate oxygens; Mg1 directly contacts G60 O6 and G78 O6; C77 and G78 H-bond terminal phosphate. 2026-06-03: updated ligand atom names to match PDBQT (O1Pa→O1C, O2Pa→O2C, O3Pa→OP1 removed, O1Pb→OP1, O2Pb→OP2) and added P/PC phosphorus atoms. 2026-06-04 Codex review: metalCoordination is intentionally not listed as an expected term because the prepared reference pose scores metalCoordination 0.000; receptor Mg atoms X:101–103 are present but not within MacVina's metal cutoff of the ligand oxygens in the current PDBQT geometry. Receptor residue numbering from literature; note: MacVina detects contacts to X:11 and X:88 (different PDBQT numbering) — residue numbering investigation pending.
